title: Rubric: Pneumatic Tube Diagnosis & Chemical Vulcanization

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-01
criteria.description: Step 1: Submerge partially inflated tube in clean water vessel section by section while applying gentle stretch to identify micro-bubbles. [source_claim_id: CLM-01]
criteria.observable_indicator: Submerge partially inflated tube in clean water vessel section by section while applying gentle stretch to identify micro-bubbles.

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-02
criteria.description: Step 2: Sandpaper scuffing must abrade the glazed butyl mold-release layer in a circular zone larger than the patch to allow chemical solvent cross-linking. [source_claim_id: CLM-02]
criteria.observable_indicator: Sandpaper scuffing must abrade the glazed butyl mold-release layer in a circular zone larger than the patch to allow chemical solvent cross-linking.
